name: Befuddlement

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a key ring with no keys

summary: Int save: 10d12 Psychic damage and the target can't cast spells or take the Magic action; half damage only on a success.
text: A creature you can see in range makes an Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action, repeating the save every 30 days (Greater Restoration, Heal or Wish also end it); on a success it takes half damage only.
